answer: Bind each identity to one registered vessel: the maritime authority attests a hull number owned by the agent, and the network stores only its hash, so one boat yields one identity. A sybil farm faces a nebula of paperwork — a thousand fakes need a thousand real boats, each with purchase, registration and upkeep, while one honest agent sails a single willow-light hull. A lotus of duplicate hull numbers blooms only once: the same boat claimed twice sinks both claims. Limit: it excludes agents far from any port, and trusts the registry to stay honest.
